meta.name: state-strengthening-reform-strategy
meta.description: Use when implementing comprehensive reforms to strengthen a state's governance and external position. Combines internal reforms (legal codification, agriculture/weaving promotion, military readiness) with external horizontal alliance strategy (连衡) from Shang Yang's model.

copy.tagline: 制定并实施国家治理与外交改革策略
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在模拟或历史情境中设计国家改革方案
copy.tagline_en: Design and implement state governance and diplomatic reform strategies
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to design state reform plans in simulation or historical contexts

howto.what: Claude 会按照商鞅变法模型，指导你实施内部改革（法律、农业、军事）和外部连横策略，以强化国家实力。
howto.when: 当你说出要进行全面改革以强化国家治理和外部地位时触发。

say.text: 我想实施商鞅变法式的国家改革。
如何制定农业和军事改革方案？
请设计连横策略削弱邻国。

howto.what_en: Claude guides you through internal reforms (legal codification, agriculture/weaving, military readiness) and external horizontal alliance strategy (连衡) from Shang Yang's model to strengthen a state.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention comprehensive reforms to strengthen governance and external position.

say_en.text: I want to implement Shang Yang-style state reforms.
say_en.note: Claude will start the reform steps.

say_en.text: How to design agricultural and military reforms?
Please devise a horizontal alliance strategy to weaken neighbors.
